# Kulhad Factory

> Clay kulhad (earthen cup) manufacturer and wholesale supplier in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. Machine-made, food-safe, unglazed terracotta cups for tea, lassi, coffee and chaat.

## Business
- Name: Kulhad Factory
- Address: Kanth Rd, Moradabad, Kasampur, Uttar Pradesh 244501, India
- Phone: +91 99978 37697, +91 87913 55306
- Email: kulhadshop@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.kulhad.shop
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Calls & WhatsApp 24/7.

- 60ml tea kulhad - Rs 1.10
- 70ml tea kulhad - Rs 1.20
- 80ml tea kulhad - Rs 1.30
- 90ml tea kulhad - Rs 1.40
- 100ml tea kulhad - Rs 1.50

Retail minimum: 100 pieces. Wholesale MOQ: 500 pieces (60-100ml), 300 pieces (200-300ml).

## Delivery areas
